title: At which layer is a safety concept most steerable vs. most detectable — and do they coincide?

original_idea.body: For ~4 safety concepts sweep all layers, measure probe AUC and steering efficacy at each, and quantify whether the argmax layers coincide.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: layer-divergence informs safety-harness design, but link skips a step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Layer sweep measuring AUC and steering efficacy; beginner-feasible.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-model design mapping, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Layer-selection studied separately; steer-vs-detect argmax comparison may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The coincidence question may be open.
